subject: Request to substitute a tankless alternate in lieu of the storage-type water heater

messages.text: We're proposing a tankless alternate in lieu of the storage-type water heater specified in Section 22 34 00 and want sign-off before we order material. We would like this reviewed before the fixture rough-in gets underway. This substitution is cost-neutral. This substitution will not affect the domestic water pressure test date. Please respond by the end of the week so we can place the order.

The submittal for a tankless alternate in lieu of the storage-type water heater specified in Section 22 34 00 is acceptable provided it shows equivalent performance data and code-compliance listings for the assembly it replaces. This substitution is cost-neutral.
